notes.title: News Adjustments
notes.notes:
After watching some content creators playing Ancestral, I decided to adjust some details for better immersion.
Adjusted the collision of the desk in the attic.
Adjusted the post process to make the view a little clearer.
Adjusted some scares for greater impact.
Adjusted the "ESC" button, so if a widget remains on the screen (which happens in rare cases), accessing the game menu will allow the widget to be automatically removed from the screen.

notes.title: AI Adjustment
notes.notes:
Update to the AI: now it can no longer see or hear, but it is faster and has unpredictable movements.
Update to some scares: Adjustments made to some moments of the game for better immersion.
FPS drop in the basement: A FPS drop occurred on some peripherals due to the AI ​​becoming stagnant looking at the player when he was in a place where it could not reach him. Now it is always moving and the FPS drop no longer occurs.
The AI ​​also no longer stands at the door waiting for the player to enter or exit.

notes.title: Returning Correction
notes.notes: Returning to the update because a problem found needs more time to be fixed, but nothing affects the gameplay.

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.notes:

Entity no longer camps
